title: Download Chat Files
description: Downloads the source files for a chat as a ZIP archive.
content:
# Download Chat Files

## Usage

<CodeVariant
language="TypeScript"
title="TypeScript Example"
code={`import  from 'v0'

const result = await v0.chats.downloadFiles({
chatId: 'chat_abc123',
})

console.log(result)`}
/>

<CodeVariant
language="cURL"
title="cURL Example"
code={`curl -X GET "https://api.v0.dev/v2/chats/chat_abc123/files/download" \
-H "Authorization: Bearer $V0_API_KEY" \
-H "Content-Type: application/json"`}
/>

## API Signature

### Request

#### Path Parameters

<APISignature
title=""
parameters={[
{
"name": "chatId",
"type": "string",
"required": true,
"description": "The unique identifier of the chat.",
"deprecated": false
}
]}
/>
